## 6. Wire protocol and session semantics
One authenticated socket connection owns one session; no reconnection/resume/re-execution in v1. UUID session assigned worker, invocation per CLI execution, caller operation ids strictly monotonic UInt64 starting1 (control ids independent channel sequencing). Client is trusted MCP but all bytes validated. Frame 4-byte big-endian length then strict UTF8 JSON, camelCase ordinal keys, reject duplicates/unknown fields/NaN, maxDepth16, request<=1MiB, control<=16KiB,event<=64KiB. 5s absolute frame transfer deadline begins at first header byte (idle waiting for next frame governed session idle deadline, not five-second polling timeout); handshake10s from accept. Hello request {version:1,profileId,policySha256,selectedStrategy,workspaceId,model:string|null,agentName:string|null,silent:bool,initialPrompt,timeoutMilliseconds:long|null}; null timeout means profile max; target user/executable/env/outputPath are NOT payload fields. WorkspaceId maps to exact canonical root, executable profile selected by strategy policy. Client explicit path canonical policy-alias equality validated before hello and worker never uses caller path for execution. HelloAck {version,epoch,sessionId,policySha256,strategy,capabilities,workerUid,sequence:0}. Initial prompt stored privately; selected strategy creates session using requested prompt after ACK; interactive may launch immediately. Client rejects changed strategy/hash/UID.
Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Send body {prompt,timeoutMilliseconds}; read body {timeoutMilliseconds}; Escape body {}; Cancel body {targetOperationId}; End body {timeoutMilliseconds}. No malformed optional union fields accepted. Event {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,sequence,kind,payload}; ProcessStarted {invocationId,agentPid,agentUid}; Output {stream:stdout|stderr|body,text}; ResultStart {state:Success|Error|Timeout|SpawnError,exitCode,contentType}; ResultChunk {field:body|stdout|stderr,text}; ResultEnd {cleanupReceiptId}; OperationCancelled {}; Error {code,correlationId}; SessionEnded {cleanupReceiptId}; State {alive,agentPid:null|positive,sessionStatus}. Result fields chunked, cap16MiB aggregate per op across body/stdout/stderr including duplicated representation; output callback streamed separately counts same raw bytes once in capture accounting, stored result fields count actual memory. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. Stream mode forwards existing yielded strings exactly, no fabricated token granularity; transport converts result/output events without double delivery. AgentCliClientOptions.AgentOutputReceivedAsync callback remains local callback replay for policy-approved outputs, not transmitted delegate; callback exceptions cancel op and clean session. Escape delegates current strategy method, no-op for strategies currently no-op; it is not transport cancellation. Cancel idempotent target current op; first terminal outcome wins cancellation/completion race under session lock. Cancellation of consuming operation sends Cancel, awaits bounded cleanup independent of caller ct, then throws OperationCanceledException locally. End/dispose idempotent, terminate active op/session; receive cleanup before acknowledgement. Client disconnect or stream-consumer abandonment cancels and ends session; no background orphan. Transport failures never retry an agent prompt automatically.
State machine Opening -> Open -> Active -> Open, or any live state -> Closing -> Closed/Faulted. Initial response consumed marker independent state. Batch process finished then PID retained as last observed agent PID, IsAlive false; next Send transitions PID on started event. Remote synchronous properties are latest observed snapshot, false/null before first started, no network query; heartbeat3s during active process, missing9s marks unknown-as-not-alive and cancels session (not proof process exited); operations surface WorkerUnavailable. One terminal event per op, sequence increments strict; duplicate/out-of-order/epoch mismatch closes and cleans; consumed op ids retained for current connection only, duplicate may return safe ProtocolViolation never rerun. No durable reconnect replay claim. Worker read and control handling independent bounded tasks; outbound queue max4events=256KiB, output total16MiB, stall frame deadline -> cleanup. Redaction constant transport/policy errors, never log requests/argv containing prompts or secrets.

## 2. Requirements/approval and change impact

## 3. Contracts and DI (lock before mocks)

## 4. Configuration schema/migration

## 4. Configuration schema/migration
New Mcp:AgentExecution: Strategies map keyed by canonical strategy: {AgentPath:string?,Model:string?,DelegationProfile:string?}; DelegationProfiles map {SocketPath:absolute,TargetUser:string,ExpectedUid:uint,ExpectedGid:uint,PolicySha256:string}. Broker checks SO_PEERCRED authorized UID before bytes; MCP checks socket parent ownership/mode/no symlinks and connected peer uid=profile ExpectedUid, not pathname alone. Policy SHA from admin profile must equal broker hash; mismatch fail.
Trust disclosure: target account owns its auth and can execute arbitrary software independently; this is bounded cooperative-agent lifecycle containment, NOT sandbox of malicious sharpninja or malicious CLI code. Do not claim cgroup prevents target user escaping to other user-manager units. Exe profiles are root-owned immutable CLI runtime snapshots staged by deployment, including launch script/interpreter/npm dependency closure for node shim tools; source-path alias maps approved original executable to installed manifest. Snapshot hash and permissions verify entire closure, refuse unresolved runtime/symlink dependency. User authentication remains user-owned; no credential copies, worker storage is not secret store. Workspace is canonical approved registered root and inode/symlink rules deny traversal aliases; workspace remains writable for real agent behavior only per existing strategy permission flags, no added always-approve. Child environment is constructed empty then policy keys HOME,USER,LOGNAME,PATH,TMPDIR,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR,DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS,LANG only. HOME account database result; PATH snapshot runtime/bin plus /usr/bin:/bin, TMPDIR private mode0700 runtime. No inherited LD_*,NODE_OPTIONS,DOTNET_*,GH_TOKEN,model key or proxy variables. Model credentials read normally from target profile. Root-protected startup rejects unknown policy fields/invalid limits; bind session to policy revision; policy change drains old sessions then restart, no live partial reload. Validate immutable executable tree before startup and each spawn; directories not writable by caller/target to close writable-binary TOCTOU. Workspace canonical root plus user-trusted mutable contents is disclosed; policy validates root handle but does not promise immutable repo content.
Containment is implemented through injected IAgentProcessSupervisor; Local supervisor wraps existing spawner unchanged for nondelegated. Worker supervisor builds ProcessStartInfo with strategy argument list but launches using root-protected generic process runner through target user manager; no separate vendor CLI logic. API: StartAsync(AgentProcessLaunch,ct)->IAgentProcessLease; lease exposes ISpawnedProcess streams/status and CloseAsync(reason,timeout) returning CleanupReceipt; verified cleanup required before returning terminal result. Per-session runner hosts the selected LOCAL CLI strategy and remains alive in Type=exec transient unit with ExitType=main, KillMode=control-group, TimeoutStartSec=10,TimeoutStopSec=5,RuntimeMaxSec=14410, NoNewPrivileges=true. On worker crash independent manager timer bounds lifetime, replacement worker must sweep before listen; user-manager/kernel unavailability blocks guarantee and requires operator recovery, no false completed receipt. Receipts contain epoch/session/op/invocation/profile/strategy/UID/PID/cgroup/exe-manifest hash/exit/cleanup booleans and times, never prompt/token/environment values. ## 6. Wire protocol and session semantics
One authenticated socket connection owns one session; no reconnection/resume/re-execution in v1. UUID session assigned worker, invocation per CLI execution, caller operation ids strictly monotonic UInt64 starting1 (control ids independent channel sequencing). Client is trusted MCP but all bytes validated. Frame 4-byte big-endian length then strict UTF8 JSON, camelCase ordinal keys, reject duplicates/unknown fields/NaN, maxDepth16, request<=1MiB, control<=16KiB,event<=64KiB. 5s absolute frame transfer deadline begins at first header byte (idle waiting for next frame governed session idle deadline, not five-second polling timeout); handshake10s from accept. Hello request {version:1,profileId,policySha256,selectedStrategy,workspaceId,model:string|null,agentName:string|null,initialPrompt,timeoutMilliseconds:long|null}; null timeout means profile max; target user/executable/env/outputPath are NOT payload fields. WorkspaceId maps to exact canonical root, executable profile selected by strategy policy. Client explicit path canonical policy-alias equality validated before hello and worker never uses caller path for execution. HelloAck {version,epoch,sessionId,policySha256,strategy,capabilities,workerUid,sequence:0}. Initial prompt stored privately; selected strategy creates session using requested prompt after ACK; interactive may launch immediately. Client rejects changed strategy/hash/UID.
Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Send body {prompt,timeoutMilliseconds}; read body {timeoutMilliseconds}; Escape body {}; Cancel body {targetOperationId}; End body {timeoutMilliseconds}. No malformed optional union fields accepted. Event {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,sequence,kind,payload}; ProcessStarted {invocationId,agentPid,agentUid}; Output {stream:stdout|stderr|body,text}; ResultStart {state:Success|Error|Timeout|SpawnError,exitCode,contentType}; ResultChunk {field:body|stdout|stderr,text}; ResultEnd {cleanupReceiptId}; OperationCancelled {}; Error {code,correlationId}; SessionEnded {cleanupReceiptId}; State {alive,agentPid:null|positive,sessionStatus}. Result fields chunked, cap16MiB aggregate per op across body/stdout/stderr including duplicated representation; output callback streamed separately counts same raw bytes once in capture accounting, stored result fields count actual memory. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. Stream mode forwards existing yielded strings exactly, no fabricated token granularity; transport converts result/output events without double delivery. IAgentExecutionSession.AgentOutputReceived callback remains local callback replay for policy-approved outputs, not transmitted delegate; callback exceptions cancel op and clean session. Escape delegates current strategy method, no-op for strategies currently no-op; it is not transport cancellation. Cancel idempotent target current op; first terminal outcome wins cancellation/completion race under session lock. Cancellation of consuming operation sends Cancel, awaits bounded cleanup independent of caller ct, then throws OperationCanceledException locally. End/dispose idempotent, terminate active op/session; receive cleanup before acknowledgement. Client disconnect or stream-consumer abandonment cancels and ends session; no background orphan. Transport failures never retry an agent prompt automatically.
State machine Opening -> Open -> Active -> Open, or any live state -> Closing -> Closed/Faulted. Initial response consumed marker independent state. Batch process finished then PID retained as last observed agent PID, IsAlive false; next Send transitions PID on started event. Remote synchronous properties are latest observed snapshot, false/null before first started, no network query; heartbeat3s during active process, missing9s marks unknown-as-not-alive and cancels session (not proof process exited); operations surface WorkerUnavailable. One terminal event per op, sequence increments strict; duplicate/out-of-order/epoch mismatch closes and cleans; consumed op ids retained for current connection only, duplicate may return safe ProtocolViolation never rerun. No durable reconnect replay claim. Worker read and control handling independent bounded tasks; outbound queue max4events=256KiB, output total16MiB, stall frame deadline -> cleanup. Redaction constant transport/policy errors, never log requests/argv containing prompts or secrets.

# Strategy-preserving Linux RunAs remediation - revision 1

## 0. Review scope, status and goal
This is a decision proposal dated October 9 2026 UTC, not implementation, architecture approval, completed requirements, test success or deployment. The user requests planning iteration until independent HV agrees. No product writes/builds/worktree creation in Plan mode. ## 1. Isolated worktree and provenance
Implementation root W=/home/sharpninja/github/McpServer-runas-remediation; branch remediation/linux-agent-runas; pinned base c195837ac888b6f02724221de6a040e63b3e6b47. EXISTING DEFAULTS/PARSER FIXES: appsettings, caller options/services, strategy/resolver/TODO changes and tests, build/LinuxServiceHelper.cs and parser tests are reference-only candidate hunks; reimplement required behavior test-first in W, do not assume TDD provenance. Register W only if independent runtime testing requires it, through supported workspace plugin operation after approval with separate server-generated marker/data; do not duplicate canonical requirements silently. ## 2. Requirements/approval and change impact
Through matching plugin effective/layer/readback workflow, revise existing FR-MCP-RUNAS-001/TR-MCP-RUNAS-001/TEST-MCP-RUNAS-001 without deleting history or satisfying AC prematurely. Remove Grok-only/helper-only restriction. Preserve identity/security/cleanup/deployment AC. Export W documentation through supported export target capability; if cannot target W, stop and obtain supported export solution, never export over O or hand-edit store. Behavior changes: invalid cross-account requests now fail instead of silently using service identity; selected strategy override no longer inherits another strategy path/model; delegated runtime has bounded policy lifetime. These are explicit safety changes needing approval. New worker/runner service/policy/socket and target-user linger are operational side effects. No DB migration except supported requirements records; no public session identity field. In-process hosted cross-account is capability-denied, not strategy silently replaced.

## 3. Contracts and DI (lock before mocks)
Move existing strategy/session/request/resolver contracts from internal Services ownership to McpServer.Common.AgentCli with public XMLDocs retaining namespace for source compatibility. Services has no dependency added back from Common. Put process-based strategy implementations into new McpServer.AgentExecution project (net10.0), referencing Common.AgentCli and existing logging/DI packages only. Preserve implementation names/namespaces and add InternalsVisibleTo for existing tests and worker runner, no package/new framework. Hosted strategy stays Services. Resolver normalization/aliases and registration aggregate remain sole choice authority. Extract CLI implementations mechanically only after mocks-first contract checks and real red.
IAgentExecutionStrategy retains Name and CreateSessionAsync(request,ct); add Capabilities record DelegatedIdentity(bool), Interaction(Batch|Interactive). Capabilities are strategy-owned, policy approval separate. CLI four=true; hosted=false. IAgentExecutionSession retains all seven methods and IsAlive/ProcessId. No method returning raw server Process introduced. Common typed AgentExecutionException has code enum StrategyUnknown,IdentityInvalid,IdentityDenied,CapabilityUnsupported,WorkerUnavailable,PolicyMismatch,ProtocolViolation,OutputLimit,CleanupFailed,SessionExpired,Busy; message constant-safe, correlation ID; rejected secrets/prompt/path never included.
Add IAgentSessionTransport.ConnectAsync(AgentExecutionSessionRequest,DelegationProfile,ct): ValueTask<IAgentExecutionSession>; IExecutionIdentityProvider.ResolveAccountAsync(name,ct): (canonicalName,uid,gid,home); IAgentExecutionSettingsResolver.Resolve(selectedStrategy,callerDefaultStrategy,legacySettings,explicitOverrides): resolved path/model/profile/runAs. Identity-aware resolver decorates each resolved strategy exactly once; local factory stores undecorated strategies. Singleton stateless resolvers/options; per-created-session mutable state, owned transport lifetime; no shared mutable CLI options across requests. Worker runner composition uses ONLY local CLI factory and does not register decorator/transport; fail startup if any remote decorator registered. Hosted registration never starts worker. All callers resolving strategies automatically receive same decorator. Direct Common CLI client cross-account request must throw before local spawn; process environment loading alone never authorizes Linux identity.

## 4. Configuration schema/migration
New Mcp:AgentExecution: Strategies map keyed by canonical strategy: {AgentPath:string?,Model:string?,DelegationProfile:string?}; DelegationProfiles map {SocketPath:absolute,TargetUser:string,ExpectedUid:uint,ExpectedGid:uint,PolicySha256:string}. All actual values discovered/captured during contract inventory BEFORE tests; unresolved default stops approval, not deferred implementation judgment. Prefer nullable opt-in settings to changing AgentCliClientOptions default for all unrelated consumers.
Precedence explicit session override > caller legacy path/model ONLY when selected==caller configured default > strategy entry > strategy intrinsic default. Legacy applies to its associated default, never another selected strategy. When both strategy setting and same caller legacy nonempty, retain legacy precedence and emit safe deprecation notice; automatic migration writes explicit strategy entry and removes only task-approved matching legacy fields, preserving unrelated caller differences via caller-scoped strategy override map if values differ; conflicts require no data loss, caller override wins. Path/model are independent; explicit auto means no model argument only per strategy semantics. Validate key aliases normalized once; conflicting alias/canonical duplicates startup error. No basename guessing for explicit executable; mismatch delegated policy fails, never rewrite silently.
AgentHelp.RunAs is nullable string: null (including absent YAML) inherits TodoPrompts.RunAs; empty/whitespace disables; nonempty trimmed canonical account. Voice preserves existing TodoPrompts identity inheritance. TODO own RunAs preserved; pool/triage use their existing source if present, otherwise empty (do not introduce automatic sharpninja identity to every feature). Per-request parameter/env cannot set identity. For delegation, no API key/GH token/environment map passed over socket in v1, and caller configured injection => explicit IdentityDenied; local behavior remains. All caller sources inventoried before mock gate; any direct process caller configured Linux RunAs must verify same UID or reject until routed, never ignore.
Windows uses unchanged profile-environment mechanism; document not Unix impersonation. Other unsupported OS + nonempty RunAs fails capability; empty remains local. Linux account resolution failure -> IdentityInvalid, same effective UID verified -> local, other UID -> admin profile lookup and remote; no fallback. Model/executable requested must match selected policy entry; an explicit path equal approved source path is permitted, maps to policy-installed canonical artifact. No session-defined arbitrary executable admitted remotely.

## 5. Worker boundary and containment
New projects McpServer.AgentWorker (broker) and McpServer.AgentWorker.Runner (per-session local-strategy host) reference AgentExecution/Common only. Broker runs as target sharpninja in a user service under systemd --user; root-owned installed application/policy. Worker policy /etc/mcpserver/agent-worker/sharpninja.json root:root 0644; parent directories root-owned non-writable by mcpserver/sharpninja. Socket /run/mcpserver-agent-worker/sharpninja.sock directory target:worker-client-group 0750, socket target:worker-client-group 0660; group grants only mcpserver access, not arbitrary users. Actual authorized peer UID list explicit; same-account adversaries are outside Unix UID authentication guarantee. Broker checks SO_PEERCRED authorized UID before bytes; MCP checks socket parent ownership/mode/no symlinks and connected peer uid=profile ExpectedUid, not pathname alone. Policy SHA from admin profile must equal broker hash; mismatch fail.
Trust disclosure: target account owns its auth and can execute arbitrary software independently; this is bounded cooperative-agent lifecycle containment, NOT sandbox of malicious sharpninja or malicious CLI code. Do not claim cgroup prevents target user escaping to other user-manager units. Exe profiles are root-owned immutable CLI runtime snapshots staged by deployment, including launch script/interpreter/npm dependency closure for node shim tools; source-path alias maps approved original executable to installed manifest. Snapshot hash and permissions verify entire closure, refuse unresolved runtime/symlink dependency. User authentication remains user-owned; no credential copies, worker storage is not secret store. Workspace is canonical approved registered root and inode/symlink rules deny traversal aliases; workspace remains writable for real agent behavior only per existing strategy permission flags, no added always-approve. Target profile credential access is operator-approved.
Child environment is constructed empty then policy keys HOME,USER,LOGNAME,PATH,TMPDIR,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR,DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS,LANG only. HOME account database result; PATH snapshot runtime/bin plus /usr/bin:/bin, TMPDIR private mode0700 runtime. No inherited LD_*,NODE_OPTIONS,DOTNET_*,GH_TOKEN,model key or proxy variables. Model credentials read normally from target profile. Root-protected startup rejects unknown policy fields/invalid limits; bind session to policy revision; policy change drains old sessions then restart, no live partial reload. Validate immutable executable tree before startup and each spawn; directories not writable by caller/target to close writable-binary TOCTOU. Workspace canonical root plus user-trusted mutable contents is disclosed; policy validates root handle but does not promise immutable repo content.
Containment is implemented through injected IAgentProcessSupervisor; Local supervisor wraps existing spawner unchanged for nondelegated. Worker supervisor builds ProcessStartInfo with strategy argument list but launches using root-protected generic process runner through target user manager; no separate vendor CLI logic. API: StartAsync(AgentProcessLaunch,ct)->IAgentProcessLease; lease exposes ISpawnedProcess streams/status and CloseAsync(reason,timeout) returning CleanupReceipt; verified cleanup required before returning terminal result. Launch includes executableProfileId,argument vector FROM selected strategy, private working resource root; never receives raw request argv. Strategy still creates/reads its prompt/output files on target side; supervisor tracks private resource paths for crash recovery.
Per-session runner hosts the selected LOCAL CLI strategy and remains alive in Type=exec transient unit with ExitType=main, KillMode=control-group, TimeoutStartSec=10,TimeoutStopSec=5,RuntimeMaxSec=14410, NoNewPrivileges=true. Batch CLI invocations are launched in separate per-invocation transient units with generic process runner holding unit active after child exit until cleanup; interactive CLI has one invocation unit lasting its session. Process runner accepts only broker/runner internal validated launch frame, reports ready without launching, waits for ACK after exact unit/PID/cgroup capture, then launches requested strategy-built command. Actual CLI UID and PID captured before output accepted. No use of shell eval. Strategy process spawner adapter supplies pipes via existing ISpawnedProcess (sync Spawn compatibility bridged with bounded startup only; no async-over-sync deadlock on synchronization context). Isolated API contract/mock tests validate this adapter before code; timeout cancels pending start and cleans exact unit even if PID unknown.
Identity/cgroup ready deadline 10s; manager queries 2s each; start ACK once; terminate SIGTERM then manager SIGKILL with TimeoutStopSec5; stop verification 10s total; final drain5s. CLI operation deadline min(requested finite timeout, profile budget); default policy maximum14400s; helper120s preserved; negative timeout except infinite sentinel invalid. Independently enforced RuntimeMaxSec for child unit = permitted run budget+15s; idle interactive max1800s; session hard lifetime14400s. Units named mcp-agent-<policy-profile>-<epoch>-<session>-<invocation>. Generate no caller unit names. Before listening/recovery, sweep only owned prefix units and recorded resources, resolve pending start jobs, verify cgroups empty then delete resources. Cleanup failure stops admission and marks health unhealthy; normal final result not released before invocation cleanup for batch. Interactive keeps process alive until Escape (strategy semantics) or End; End verifies unit stop/descendants/files. On worker crash independent manager timer bounds lifetime, replacement worker must sweep before listen; user-manager/kernel unavailability blocks guarantee and requires operator recovery, no false completed receipt. Reparent/double-fork within unit tested; malicious deliberate cgroup escape outside claim.
Receipts contain epoch/session/op/invocation/profile/strategy/UID/PID/cgroup/exe-manifest hash/exit/cleanup booleans and times, never prompt/token/environment values. Success requires actual agent exit/result semantics and verified cleanup, not EOF/runner exit/PID disappearance. MemoryMax1GiB,TasksMax256,CPUQuota200%, one active operation globally, eight authenticated connections incl idle sessions, no unbounded queue; excess Busy explicit. Profile can lower but not increase compiled ceilings without new reviewed policy change.

## 6. Wire protocol and session semantics
One authenticated socket connection owns one session; no reconnection/resume/re-execution in v1. UUID session assigned worker, invocation per CLI execution, caller operation ids strictly monotonic UInt64 starting1 (control ids independent channel sequencing). Client is trusted MCP but all bytes validated. Frame 4-byte big-endian length then strict UTF8 JSON, camelCase ordinal keys, reject duplicates/unknown fields/NaN, maxDepth16, request<=1MiB, control<=16KiB,event<=64KiB. 5s absolute frame transfer deadline begins at first header byte (idle waiting for next frame governed session idle deadline, not five-second polling timeout); handshake10s from accept. Hello request {version:1,profileId,policySha256,selectedStrategy,workspaceId,model:string|null,agentName:string|null,initialPrompt,timeoutMilliseconds:long|null}; null timeout means profile max; target user/executable/env/outputPath are NOT payload fields. WorkspaceId maps to exact canonical root, executable profile selected by strategy policy. Client explicit path canonical policy-alias equality validated before hello and worker never uses caller path for execution. HelloAck {version,epoch,sessionId,policySha256,strategy,capabilities,workerUid,sequence:0}. Initial prompt stored privately; selected strategy creates session using requested prompt after ACK; interactive may launch immediately. Client rejects changed strategy/hash/UID.
Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Send body {prompt,timeoutMilliseconds}; read body {timeoutMilliseconds}; Escape body {}; Cancel body {targetOperationId}; End body {timeoutMilliseconds}. No malformed optional union fields accepted. Event {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,sequence,kind,payload}; ProcessStarted {invocationId,agentPid,agentUid}; Output {stream:stdout|stderr|body,text}; ResultStart {state:Success|Error|Timeout|SpawnError,exitCode,contentType}; ResultChunk {field:body|stdout|stderr,text}; ResultEnd {cleanupReceiptId}; OperationCancelled {}; Error {code,correlationId}; SessionEnded {cleanupReceiptId}; State {alive,agentPid:null|positive,sessionStatus}. Result fields chunked, cap16MiB aggregate per op across body/stdout/stderr including duplicated representation; output callback streamed separately counts same raw bytes once in capture accounting, stored result fields count actual memory. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. Stream mode forwards existing yielded strings exactly, no fabricated token granularity; transport converts result/output events without double delivery. IAgentExecutionSession.AgentOutputReceived callback remains local callback replay for policy-approved outputs, not transmitted delegate; callback exceptions cancel op and clean session. Escape delegates current strategy method, no-op for strategies currently no-op; it is not transport cancellation. Cancel idempotent target current op; first terminal outcome wins cancellation/completion race under session lock. Cancellation of consuming operation sends Cancel, awaits bounded cleanup independent of caller ct, then throws OperationCanceledException locally. End/dispose idempotent, terminate active op/session; receive cleanup before acknowledgement. Client disconnect or stream-consumer abandonment cancels and ends session; no background orphan. Transport failures never retry an agent prompt automatically.
State machine Opening -> Open -> Active -> Open, or any live state -> Closing -> Closed/Faulted. Initial response consumed marker independent state. Batch process finished then PID retained as last observed agent PID, IsAlive false; next Send transitions PID on started event. Remote synchronous properties are latest observed snapshot, false/null before first started, no network query; heartbeat3s during active process, missing9s marks unknown-as-not-alive and cancels session (not proof process exited); operations surface WorkerUnavailable. One terminal event per op, sequence increments strict; duplicate/out-of-order/epoch mismatch closes and cleans; consumed op ids retained for current connection only, duplicate may return safe ProtocolViolation never rerun. No durable reconnect replay claim. Worker read and control handling independent bounded tasks; outbound queue max4events=256KiB, output total16MiB, stall frame deadline -> cleanup. Redaction constant transport/policy errors, never log requests/argv containing prompts or secrets.

## 7. BDPv4 increments, mock validation and evidence

I1 SettingsIsolation: SharedSettingsContractTests (wrong legacy leak mock; CodexOverride_UsesCodexPath, ExplicitPath_NotRewritten, ModelIsolation, AliasConflictRejected, NullEmptyRunAs); mocks->current Helper_CodexOverride_DoesNotInheritGrok->shared settings implementation->full gate.

## 6. Wire protocol and session semantics
One authenticated socket connection owns one session; no reconnection/resume/re-execution in v1. Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. Stream mode forwards existing yielded strings exactly, no fabricated token granularity; transport converts result/output events without double delivery. IAgentExecutionSession.AgentOutputReceived callback remains local callback replay for policy-approved outputs, not transmitted delegate; callback exceptions cancel op and clean session. Escape delegates current strategy method, no-op for strategies currently no-op; it is not transport cancellation. Cancel idempotent target current op; first terminal outcome wins cancellation/completion race under session lock. Cancellation of consuming operation sends Cancel, awaits bounded cleanup independent of caller ct, then throws OperationCanceledException locally. End/dispose idempotent, terminate active op/session; receive cleanup before acknowledgement. Client disconnect or stream-consumer abandonment cancels and ends session; no background orphan. Remote synchronous properties are latest observed snapshot, false/null before first started, no network query; heartbeat3s during active process, missing9s marks unknown-as-not-alive and cancels session (not proof process exited); operations surface WorkerUnavailable. One terminal event per op, sequence increments strict; duplicate/out-of-order/epoch mismatch closes and cleans; consumed op ids retained for current connection only, duplicate may return safe ProtocolViolation never rerun. No durable reconnect replay claim. Worker read and control handling independent bounded tasks; outbound queue max4events=256KiB, output total16MiB, stall frame deadline -> cleanup. # Strategy-preserving Linux RunAs remediation - revision 1

## 0. Review scope, status and goal
This is a decision proposal dated October 9 2026 UTC, not implementation, architecture approval, completed requirements, test success or deployment. The user requests planning iteration until independent HV agrees. No product writes/builds/worktree creation in Plan mode. Reviews assess future plan adequacy; unavailable future build/UID evidence is an implementation gate, not a claim of current success. Required review artifact/audit failures remain explicit blockers, never downgraded by high technical scores. Parent and reviewer must not claim formal HV accepted without required full JSONL, entire verdict audit and persistence proof.
Goal: defaults-only live Agent Helper returns completed answer from real Grok CLI as sharpninja; server remains mcpserver, NoNewPrivileges=true. Grok is default, not exclusive. Preserve selectable copilot-cli, codex-cli, one-shot-cli, grok-cli, hosted-mcp-agent and legacy aliases. Fix helper/TODO/voice executable/model leakage, no silent Linux identity fallback in other paths. Scope is shared execution/settings correctness plus generic delegated CLI sessions. Do not change brain-slot selections, unrelated APIs, benchmark outputs, GitVersion, global profiles or existing recovery worktrees. Hosted cross-account execution is explicitly unsupported; local hosted behavior remains.

## 1. Isolated worktree and provenance
Implementation root W=/home/sharpninja/github/McpServer-runas-remediation; branch remediation/linux-agent-runas; pinned base c195837ac888b6f02724221de6a040e63b3e6b47. Create after Act approval with git -C /home/sharpninja/github/McpServer worktree add -b remediation/linux-agent-runas W <pinned-base>. Collision stops; no reuse/reset/stash/clean/prune. Original O=/home/sharpninja/github/McpServer is read-only source/evidence. Separate already-existing recovery worktrees are untouched.
Before add, archive tracked staged/unstaged diff and untracked task-file hashes into an operator-approved receipt bundle; never credentials/runtime caches. Reconcile each changed hunk with source SHA, category and disposition. No blanket transfer of uncommitted code. RETAIN AS HISTORY ONLY: O/docs/plans/Linux-Grok-RunAs-Worker.md and its review/request/response receipts. DO NOT PORT AS PRODUCT: GrokWorkerRequest.cs, GrokWorkerFraming.cs, GrokWorkerFrameTests.cs; rewrite tested generic contracts after mocks gate. EXISTING DEFAULTS/PARSER FIXES: appsettings, caller options/services, strategy/resolver/TODO changes and tests, build/LinuxServiceHelper.cs and parser tests are reference-only candidate hunks; reimplement required behavior test-first in W, do not assume TDD provenance. Unrelated staged GitVersion, benchmark changes and .claude/worktrees excluded. Existing mistakes remain historical violations, not retroactively approved.
Only W receives new code/docs/tests/evidence after Act authorization. Final plan W/docs/plans/Linux-Agent-RunAs-Remediation.md; receipts W/docs/receipts/runas-remediation/<increment>/<gate>/; executable command cwd W and source paths W. Runtime production workspace remains O, never W. Admin staging uses a separate registered workspace under /home/sharpninja/github/McpServer-runas-staging and dedicated port/service/socket/data; no calls to production during staging.
MCP coordination canonical workspace remains O for existing FR/TR/TEST and review audit. Plugin invocations explicitly pass WorkspacePath=O and context paths W; verify server workspace readback before mutation. Do NOT copy/edit a signed marker into W pretending it targets W. Register W only if independent runtime testing requires it, through supported workspace plugin operation after approval with separate server-generated marker/data; do not duplicate canonical requirements silently. No product edits until canonical requirements and audit writes/readbacks work. Tool-acknowledged local cache alone is not persistence proof.

## 2. Requirements/approval and change impact
Through matching plugin effective/layer/readback workflow, revise existing FR-MCP-RUNAS-001/TR-MCP-RUNAS-001/TEST-MCP-RUNAS-001 without deleting history or satisfying AC prematurely. Remove Grok-only/helper-only restriction. Preserve identity/security/cleanup/deployment AC. Reconcile missing FR-MCP-GROKDEFAULTS-001 with operator intent; create only after authoritative ID preflight, map existing TR/TEST or introduce canonical IDs approved in capture. Add selection isolation, capability, complete session semantics and strict phase gates to structured AC. No unapproved future-layer work. Export W documentation through supported export target capability; if cannot target W, stop and obtain supported export solution, never export over O or hand-edit store. Requirements mappings and documentation exact-readback gate before tests.
Behavior changes: invalid cross-account requests now fail instead of silently using service identity; selected strategy override no longer inherits another strategy path/model; delegated runtime has bounded policy lifetime. These are explicit safety changes needing approval. New worker/runner service/policy/socket and target-user linger are operational side effects. No DB migration except supported requirements records; no public session identity field. In-process hosted cross-account is capability-denied, not strategy silently replaced.

## 3. Contracts and DI (lock before mocks)
Move existing strategy/session/request/resolver contracts from internal Services ownership to McpServer.Common.AgentCli with public XMLDocs retaining namespace for source compatibility. Services has no dependency added back from Common. Put process-based strategy implementations into new McpServer.AgentExecution project (net10.0), referencing Common.AgentCli and existing logging/DI packages only. Preserve implementation names/namespaces and add InternalsVisibleTo for existing tests and worker runner, no package/new framework. Hosted strategy stays Services. Resolver normalization/aliases and registration aggregate remain sole choice authority. Extract CLI implementations mechanically only after mocks-first contract checks and real red.
IAgentExecutionStrategy retains Name and CreateSessionAsync(request,ct); add Capabilities record DelegatedIdentity(bool), Interaction(Batch|Interactive). Capabilities are strategy-owned, policy approval separate. CLI four=true; hosted=false. IAgentExecutionSession retains all seven methods and IsAlive/ProcessId. No method returning raw server Process introduced. Common typed AgentExecutionException has code enum StrategyUnknown,IdentityInvalid,IdentityDenied,CapabilityUnsupported,WorkerUnavailable,PolicyMismatch,ProtocolViolation,OutputLimit,CleanupFailed,SessionExpired,Busy; message constant-safe, correlation ID; rejected secrets/prompt/path never included.
Add IAgentSessionTransport.ConnectAsync(AgentExecutionSessionRequest,DelegationProfile,ct): ValueTask<IAgentExecutionSession>; IExecutionIdentityProvider.ResolveAccountAsync(name,ct): (canonicalName,uid,gid,home); IAgentExecutionSettingsResolver.Resolve(selectedStrategy,callerDefaultStrategy,legacySettings,explicitOverrides): resolved path/model/profile/runAs. Identity-aware resolver decorates each resolved strategy exactly once; local factory stores undecorated strategies. Singleton stateless resolvers/options; per-created-session mutable state, owned transport lifetime; no shared mutable CLI options across requests. Worker runner composition uses ONLY local CLI factory and does not register decorator/transport; fail startup if any remote decorator registered. Hosted registration never starts worker. All callers resolving strategies automatically receive same decorator. Direct Common CLI client cross-account request must throw before local spawn; process environment loading alone never authorizes Linux identity.

## 4. Configuration schema/migration
New Mcp:AgentExecution: Strategies map keyed by canonical strategy: {AgentPath:string?,Model:string?,DelegationProfile:string?}; DelegationProfiles map {SocketPath:absolute,TargetUser:string,ExpectedUid:uint,ExpectedGid:uint,PolicySha256:string}. Defaults each strategy owns: grok-cli=grok, codex-cli=codex, copilot-cli=preserve current copilot-client executable behavior at pinned base, one-shot-cli=preserve current generic default; hosted ignores path. All actual values discovered/captured during contract inventory BEFORE tests; unresolved default stops approval, not deferred implementation judgment. Prefer nullable opt-in settings to changing AgentCliClientOptions default for all unrelated consumers.
Precedence explicit session override > caller legacy path/model ONLY when selected==caller configured default > strategy entry > strategy intrinsic default. Legacy applies to its associated default, never another selected strategy. When both strategy setting and same caller legacy nonempty, retain legacy precedence and emit safe deprecation notice; automatic migration writes explicit strategy entry and removes only task-approved matching legacy fields, preserving unrelated caller differences via caller-scoped strategy override map if values differ; conflicts require no data loss, caller override wins. Path/model are independent; explicit auto means no model argument only per strategy semantics. Validate key aliases normalized once; conflicting alias/canonical duplicates startup error. No basename guessing for explicit executable; mismatch delegated policy fails, never rewrite silently.
AgentHelp.RunAs is nullable string: null (including absent YAML) inherits TodoPrompts.RunAs; empty/whitespace disables; nonempty trimmed canonical account. Voice preserves existing TodoPrompts identity inheritance. TODO own RunAs preserved; pool/triage use their existing source if present, otherwise empty (do not introduce automatic sharpninja identity to every feature). Per-request parameter/env cannot set identity. For delegation, no API key/GH token/environment map passed over socket in v1, and caller configured injection => explicit IdentityDenied; local behavior remains. All caller sources inventoried before mock gate; any direct process caller configured Linux RunAs must verify same UID or reject until routed, never ignore.
Windows uses unchanged profile-environment mechanism; document not Unix impersonation. Other unsupported OS + nonempty RunAs fails capability; empty remains local. Linux account resolution failure -> IdentityInvalid, same effective UID verified -> local, other UID -> admin profile lookup and remote; no fallback. Model/executable requested must match selected policy entry; an explicit path equal approved source path is permitted, maps to policy-installed canonical artifact. No session-defined arbitrary executable admitted remotely.

## 5. Worker boundary and containment
New projects McpServer.AgentWorker (broker) and McpServer.AgentWorker.Runner (per-session local-strategy host) reference AgentExecution/Common only. Broker runs as target sharpninja in a user service under systemd --user; root-owned installed application/policy. Worker policy /etc/mcpserver/agent-worker/sharpninja.json root:root 0644; parent directories root-owned non-writable by mcpserver/sharpninja. Socket /run/mcpserver-agent-worker/sharpninja.sock directory target:worker-client-group 0750, socket target:worker-client-group 0660; group grants only mcpserver access, not arbitrary users. Actual authorized peer UID list explicit; same-account adversaries are outside Unix UID authentication guarantee. Broker checks SO_PEERCRED authorized UID before bytes; MCP checks socket parent ownership/mode/no symlinks and connected peer uid=profile ExpectedUid, not pathname alone. Policy SHA from admin profile must equal broker hash; mismatch fail.
Trust disclosure: target account owns its auth and can execute arbitrary software independently; this is bounded cooperative-agent lifecycle containment, NOT sandbox of malicious sharpninja or malicious CLI code. Do not claim cgroup prevents target user escaping to other user-manager units. Exe profiles are root-owned immutable CLI runtime snapshots staged by deployment, including launch script/interpreter/npm dependency closure for node shim tools; source-path alias maps approved original executable to installed manifest. Snapshot hash and permissions verify entire closure, refuse unresolved runtime/symlink dependency. User authentication remains user-owned; no credential copies, worker storage is not secret store. Workspace is canonical approved registered root and inode/symlink rules deny traversal aliases; workspace remains writable for real agent behavior only per existing strategy permission flags, no added always-approve. Target profile credential access is operator-approved.
Child environment is constructed empty then policy keys HOME,USER,LOGNAME,PATH,TMPDIR,XDG_RUNTIME_DIR,DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS,LANG only. HOME account database result; PATH snapshot runtime/bin plus /usr/bin:/bin, TMPDIR private mode0700 runtime. No inherited LD_*,NODE_OPTIONS,DOTNET_*,GH_TOKEN,model key or proxy variables. Model credentials read normally from target profile. Root-protected startup rejects unknown policy fields/invalid limits; bind session to policy revision; policy change drains old sessions then restart, no live partial reload. Validate immutable executable tree before startup and each spawn; directories not writable by caller/target to close writable-binary TOCTOU. Workspace canonical root plus user-trusted mutable contents is disclosed; policy validates root handle but does not promise immutable repo content.
Containment is implemented through injected IAgentProcessSupervisor; Local supervisor wraps existing spawner unchanged for nondelegated. Worker supervisor builds ProcessStartInfo with strategy argument list but launches using root-protected generic process runner through target user manager; no separate vendor CLI logic. API: StartAsync(AgentProcessLaunch,ct)->IAgentProcessLease; lease exposes ISpawnedProcess streams/status and CloseAsync(reason,timeout) returning CleanupReceipt; verified cleanup required before returning terminal result. Launch includes executableProfileId,argument vector FROM selected strategy, private working resource root; never receives raw request argv. Strategy still creates/reads its prompt/output files on target side; supervisor tracks private resource paths for crash recovery.
Per-session runner hosts the selected LOCAL CLI strategy and remains alive in Type=exec transient unit with ExitType=main, KillMode=control-group, TimeoutStartSec=10,TimeoutStopSec=5,RuntimeMaxSec=14410, NoNewPrivileges=true. Batch CLI invocations are launched in separate per-invocation transient units with generic process runner holding unit active after child exit until cleanup; interactive CLI has one invocation unit lasting its session. Process runner accepts only broker/runner internal validated launch frame, reports ready without launching, waits for ACK after exact unit/PID/cgroup capture, then launches requested strategy-built command. Actual CLI UID and PID captured before output accepted. No use of shell eval. Strategy process spawner adapter supplies pipes via existing ISpawnedProcess (sync Spawn compatibility bridged with bounded startup only; no async-over-sync deadlock on synchronization context). Isolated API contract/mock tests validate this adapter before code; timeout cancels pending start and cleans exact unit even if PID unknown.
Identity/cgroup ready deadline 10s; manager queries 2s each; start ACK once; terminate SIGTERM then manager SIGKILL with TimeoutStopSec5; stop verification 10s total; final drain5s. CLI operation deadline min(requested finite timeout, profile budget); default policy maximum14400s; helper120s preserved; negative timeout except infinite sentinel invalid. Independently enforced RuntimeMaxSec for child unit = permitted run budget+15s; idle interactive max1800s; session hard lifetime14400s. Units named mcp-agent-<policy-profile>-<epoch>-<session>-<invocation>. Generate no caller unit names. Before listening/recovery, sweep only owned prefix units and recorded resources, resolve pending start jobs, verify cgroups empty then delete resources. Cleanup failure stops admission and marks health unhealthy; normal final result not released before invocation cleanup for batch. Interactive keeps process alive until Escape (strategy semantics) or End; End verifies unit stop/descendants/files. On worker crash independent manager timer bounds lifetime, replacement worker must sweep before listen; user-manager/kernel unavailability blocks guarantee and requires operator recovery, no false completed receipt. Reparent/double-fork within unit tested; malicious deliberate cgroup escape outside claim.
Receipts contain epoch/session/op/invocation/profile/strategy/UID/PID/cgroup/exe-manifest hash/exit/cleanup booleans and times, never prompt/token/environment values. Success requires actual agent exit/result semantics and verified cleanup, not EOF/runner exit/PID disappearance. MemoryMax1GiB,TasksMax256,CPUQuota200%, one active operation globally, eight authenticated connections incl idle sessions, no unbounded queue; excess Busy explicit. Profile can lower but not increase compiled ceilings without new reviewed policy change.

## 6. Wire protocol and session semantics
One authenticated socket connection owns one session; no reconnection/resume/re-execution in v1. UUID session assigned worker, invocation per CLI execution, caller operation ids strictly monotonic UInt64 starting1 (control ids independent channel sequencing). Client is trusted MCP but all bytes validated. Frame 4-byte big-endian length then strict UTF8 JSON, camelCase ordinal keys, reject duplicates/unknown fields/NaN, maxDepth16, request<=1MiB, control<=16KiB,event<=64KiB. 5s absolute frame transfer deadline begins at first header byte (idle waiting for next frame governed session idle deadline, not five-second polling timeout); handshake10s from accept. Hello request {version:1,profileId,policySha256,selectedStrategy,workspaceId,model:string|null,agentName:string|null,initialPrompt,timeoutMilliseconds:long|null}; null timeout means profile max; target user/executable/env/outputPath are NOT payload fields. WorkspaceId maps to exact canonical root, executable profile selected by strategy policy. Client explicit path canonical policy-alias equality validated before hello and worker never uses caller path for execution. HelloAck {version,epoch,sessionId,policySha256,strategy,capabilities,workerUid,sequence:0}. Initial prompt stored privately; selected strategy creates session using requested prompt after ACK; interactive may launch immediately. Client rejects changed strategy/hash/UID.
Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Send body {prompt,timeoutMilliseconds}; read body {timeoutMilliseconds}; Escape body {}; Cancel body {targetOperationId}; End body {timeoutMilliseconds}. No malformed optional union fields accepted. Event {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,sequence,kind,payload}; ProcessStarted {invocationId,agentPid,agentUid}; Output {stream:stdout|stderr|body,text}; ResultStart {state:Success|Error|Timeout|SpawnError,exitCode,contentType}; ResultChunk {field:body|stdout|stderr,text}; ResultEnd {cleanupReceiptId}; OperationCancelled {}; Error {code,correlationId}; SessionEnded {cleanupReceiptId}; State {alive,agentPid:null|positive,sessionStatus}. Result fields chunked, cap16MiB aggregate per op across body/stdout/stderr including duplicated representation; output callback streamed separately counts same raw bytes once in capture accounting, stored result fields count actual memory. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. UUID session assigned worker, invocation per CLI execution, caller operation ids strictly monotonic UInt64 starting1 (control ids independent channel sequencing). Client is trusted MCP but all bytes validated. Frame 4-byte big-endian length then strict UTF8 JSON, camelCase ordinal keys, reject duplicates/unknown fields/NaN, maxDepth16, request<=1MiB, control<=16KiB,event<=64KiB. 5s absolute frame transfer deadline begins at first header byte (idle waiting for next frame governed session idle deadline, not five-second polling timeout); handshake10s from accept. Hello request {version:1,profileId,policySha256,selectedStrategy,workspaceId,model:string|null,agentName:string|null,initialPrompt,timeoutMilliseconds:long|null}; null timeout means profile max; target user/executable/env/outputPath are NOT payload fields. WorkspaceId maps to exact canonical root, executable profile selected by strategy policy. Client explicit path canonical policy-alias equality validated before hello and worker never uses caller path for execution. HelloAck {version,epoch,sessionId,policySha256,strategy,capabilities,workerUid,sequence:0}. Initial prompt stored privately; selected strategy creates session using requested prompt after ACK; interactive may launch immediately. Client rejects changed strategy/hash/UID.
Command envelope {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,kind,body}; kind InitialRead,InitialStream,Send,SendStream,Escape,Cancel,End. Send body {prompt,timeoutMilliseconds}; read body {timeoutMilliseconds}; Escape body {}; Cancel body {targetOperationId}; End body {timeoutMilliseconds}. No malformed optional union fields accepted. Event {version,epoch,sessionId,operationId,sequence,kind,payload}; ProcessStarted {invocationId,agentPid,agentUid}; Output {stream:stdout|stderr|body,text}; ResultStart {state:Success|Error|Timeout|SpawnError,exitCode,contentType}; ResultChunk {field:body|stdout|stderr,text}; ResultEnd {cleanupReceiptId}; OperationCancelled {}; Error {code,correlationId}; SessionEnded {cleanupReceiptId}; State {alive,agentPid:null|positive,sessionStatus}. Result fields chunked, cap16MiB aggregate per op across body/stdout/stderr including duplicated representation; output callback streamed separately counts same raw bytes once in capture accounting, stored result fields count actual memory. Parsed is NOT serialized polymorphic CLR object: reconstruct existing parser from body/contentType, semantically same JSON/YAML parsed structure; typed data preservation tests mandatory.
First InitialRead or InitialStream consumes initial response exactly once; repeat=>ProtocolViolation. One response operation active per session; concurrent second returns Busy, no queued execution; global operation slot likewise. Send allowed only after initial operation returns successfully/nonfatal agent result and according to underlying strategy IsAlive semantics (batch permits another invocation even if IsAlive=false); Send does not require persistent process. Stream mode forwards existing yielded strings exactly, no fabricated token granularity; transport converts result/output events without double delivery. IAgentExecutionSession.AgentOutputReceived callback remains local callback replay for policy-approved outputs, not transmitted delegate; callback exceptions cancel op and clean session. Escape delegates current strategy method, no-op for strategies currently no-op; it is not transport cancellation. Cancel idempotent target current op; first terminal outcome wins cancellation/completion race under session lock. Cancellation of consuming operation sends Cancel, awaits bounded cleanup independent of caller ct, then throws OperationCanceledException locally. End/dispose idempotent, terminate active op/session; receive cleanup before acknowledgement. Client disconnect or stream-consumer abandonment cancels and ends session; no background orphan. Transport failures never retry an agent prompt automatically.
State machine Opening -> Open -> Active -> Open, or any live state -> Closing -> Closed/Faulted. Initial response consumed marker independent state. Batch process finished then PID retained as last observed agent PID, IsAlive false; next Send transitions PID on started event. Remote synchronous properties are latest observed snapshot, false/null before first started, no network query; heartbeat3s during active process, missing9s marks unknown-as-not-alive and cancels session (not proof process exited); operations surface WorkerUnavailable. One terminal event per op, sequence increments strict; duplicate/out-of-order/epoch mismatch closes and cleans; consumed op ids retained for current connection only, duplicate may return safe ProtocolViolation never rerun. No durable reconnect replay claim. Worker read and control handling independent bounded tasks; outbound queue max4events=256KiB, output total16MiB, stall frame deadline -> cleanup. Redaction constant transport/policy errors, never log requests/argv containing prompts or secrets.

### F1 - PASS: helper-only routing is explicit

Plan 78-88 selects a dedicated `IAgentHelpExecutionRouter`, injected only into AgentHelpConversationService, rather than routing in shared Grok strategy by generic RunAs. It rejects other selected strategies with effective RunAs, including session overrides, and requires excluded-caller tests. Plan 57-65 states option precedence and local/Windows behavior. This closes the original predicate ambiguity without pretending to fix TODO, voice, triage or persistent sessions. Prove these boundaries in red tests later; absent code is not penalized here.

Plan 124-160 materially improves containment: per-invocation user-manager service, Type=exec, ExitType=main, KillMode=control-group, SendSIGKILL, stop/runtime limits, independent output draining, cleanup-dependent success, unhealthy-on-cleanup-failure, restart sweep, manager preflight and explicit non-sandbox trust. These mechanisms address reparented descendants for cooperative Grok subprocesses. The system worker's own KillMode is no longer overread as per-invocation containment.

**Concrete defect: plan 133-134 says omitting `--collect` retains terminal status until the worker records ExecMainCode/ExecMainStatus/Result and cgroup emptiness. That is false for successful inactive units.** Official systemd-run documentation says successful units are unloaded immediately; omitting `--collect` retains failed units, not every completed unit. systemd.unit says unloading loses execution results and lists active IPC-client pinning as a retention mechanism. `--wait` reports main-process outcome while monitoring; it does not promise a separate worker can query after systemd-run exits. Immediate-success invocations can race property read. A later not-found unit must not be exit-status or cleanup proof.

**Required action:** specify a race-free retention/capture protocol, such as an independently held manager reference established before execution can finish, retained through terminal property and cgroup capture, then released. Define crash/disconnect release and failed-unit reset. If choosing another mechanism, show compatibility with `--pipe`, `--wait`, ExitType=main and descendant stop. Do not simply add RemainAfterExit: systemd-run documents `--wait` as incompatible with `--remain-after-exit`, and remaining active changes normal-exit cleanup.

**Also bound launch/control phases:** RuntimeMaxSec bounds active runtime, not start-job duration. Pin TimeoutStartSec or equivalent manager-backed start bound, plus start/query/stop RPC/launcher deadlines. Make the crash deadline cover starting + active runtime + stopping, not just runtime + stopping. Distinguish process cleanup from prompt-file cleanup: a dead worker cannot delete files until replacement/sweep or another specified cleanup owner runs.

**Tests:** immediate exit 0/nonzero, scheduling delay before status read, worker death before/after main exit, start hang/manager loss, retention release, no failed-unit accumulation. A transient **service** is spawned by the user manager, not by the worker; `--pipe` transfers standard descriptors, not the worker environment.
